ask: How should teams translate passage titles and other text around the passages?
problem: Book names now show in the team's language. Passage titles and other text around the passages still show only in the template's language. A Nepali team sees English titles like "The lost son" on the Map, the Next line and the passage page.
found: Passage titles, outline section titles, piece words, review flow steps and guide text still show only in the template's language. Today an admin must rename each passage by hand.
changed: Nothing yet. I did not build anything. This card needs your choice first.
why: Three ways exist. A: the team renames by hand. It is simple but is thousands of titles of work. B: LangQuest publishes title sets in each language and the team picks one, as with book names (decision 193). A team rename still wins. C: each person sees titles in their app language. I recommend B. It matches book names, gives everyone on a team the same titles, and needs no work to start. I rejected C because two people on one team would see different titles. B needs your approval of machine translated titles, as you gave for book names. The pieces words and flow steps would follow in a second change using the same sets.
touches: New library kind and a new event in the language's stream, so older app builds ignore it. It adds a decision entry and a seed run in the live library. It does not change Play Store answers.
